name: project-control-system
description: A general project control and scaffolding system for bootstrapping projects with AI collaboration layers (AGENTS.md, project-control/, .ai/) and organizing complex work into control docs, phase tasks, ownership, decisions, reviews, archives, and Git-backed change records.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap projects with AI collaboration layers and organize control docs.
interface.longDescription: A general project control and scaffolding plugin for bootstrapping projects with AI collaboration layers. It uses a three-layer architecture: AGENTS.md as the entry point for AI agents, project-control/ for control documents, phase tasks, role ownership, decisions, execution notes, reviews, archives, and Git-backed change records, and .ai/ for reusable AI skills, rules, and commands. Optional tech-stack templates can be applied without assuming a specific project domain.
defaultPrompt: Scaffold this project with AGENTS.md, project-control/, and .ai/ collaboration layer.
Create control docs, phase tasks, and ownership in project-control/.
Set up AI skills, rules, and commands in .ai/ for reusable workflows.
Separate current work, research, reviews, and archives.
